# Problem 1

Let's load in the packages needed

```{r}
library(remotes)
library(flowWorkspace)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggcyto)
library(flowGate)
library(openCyto)
```

Now, we have to locate the files:
```{r}
StorageLocation <- file.path("C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/08_WaysToGate/homeworks/MacarenaLM-week8")
fcs_files <- list.files(StorageLocation, pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)
fcs_files
```
[1] "C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/08_WaysToGate/homeworks/MacarenaLM-week8/WT interLimbs 11.5 7AAD SORT FSC 4 BSC35 TH5 - 11_[5 mL Tubes] Data Source - 1.fcs"
[2] "C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/08_WaysToGate/homeworks/MacarenaLM-week8/YFP+7AAD INTERLIMBS 11.5 FSC 4 BSC35 TH9 SORT - 2_[5 mL Tubes] Data Source - 1.fcs"

Next, we are going to set up the GatingSet, to see the parameters that we are managing and select those that we are going to apply the biexponential transformation to stablish the GatingSet.
```{r}
SFC_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcs_files, truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)
SFC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(SFC_cytoset)
```

```{r}
SFC_Parameters <- colnames(SFC_GatingSet)
SFC_Parameters
```
 [1] "TIME"  "FSC-A" "FSC-H" "FSC-W" "SSC-A" "SSC-H" "SSC-W" "FL1-A" "FL2-A" "FL4-A"

 ```{r}
 FluorophoresOnly <- SFC_Parameters[!stringr::str_detect(SFC_Parameters, "FSC|SSC|TIME")]
 ```
 ```{r}
 Biexponential <- flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=262144, pos=4.5, neg=2, widthBasis=-500)
 ```
 ```{r}
 MyBiexTransform <- transformerList(FluorophoresOnly, Biexponential)
 transform(SFC_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)
 ```
 A GatingSet with 2 samples
 
 Manually, we are going to select the different populations that we are interested on. We are going to check the plot and the cell number of the gate:
 ```{r}
flowGate::gs_gate_interactive(gs=SFC_GatingSet, filterId="cell population", sample=1, dims=list("FSC-A", "SSC-A"), subset="root")
 ```

# Problem 2

I use my own data for the previous problem. Now, I'am going to use the csv file from the course because I don't have one of my own. So, let's stablish the location of this file first:
```{r}
StorageLocation2 <- file.path("C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/08_WaysToGate/data")
GateTemplate <- list.files(StorageLocation2, pattern=".csv", full.names=TRUE)
GateTemplate
```
[1] "C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/08_WaysToGate/data/GatesUnmixed.csv"

Now, we have to load the gates in:
```{r}
GatesToApply <- data.table::fread(GateTemplate)
```

And add the gates to the GatingSet
```{r}
TheFullTemplate <- gatingTemplate(GatesToApply)
```
Adding population:singlets
Adding population:lymphocytes
Adding population:live
Adding population:Tcells
Adding population:CD4
Adding population:CD8

```{r}
TheFullTemplate
```
--- Gating Template: default
	with  7  populations defined

```{r}
class(TheFullTemplate)
```
[1] "gatingTemplate"
attr(,"package")
[1] "openCyto"

For the assemble of the GatingSet object, we will need the fcs files, so we have to locate them first:
```{r}
StorageLocation3 <- file.path("C:/Users/Macarena/CytometryInR/course/08_WaysToGate/data")
fcs_files <- list.files(StorageLocation3, pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)
fcs_files
```
And now, we can assemble the GatingSet object:

```{r}
SFC_cytoset <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcs_files, truncate_max_range = FALSE, transformation = FALSE)
SFC_GatingSet <- GatingSet(SFC_cytoset)
```

```{r}
SFC_Parameters <- colnames(SFC_GatingSet)
FluorophoresOnly <- SFC_Parameters[!stringr::str_detect(SFC_Parameters, "FSC|SSC|Time")]
Biexponential <- flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=262144, pos=4.5, neg=2, widthBasis=-500)
MyBiexTransform <- transformerList(FluorophoresOnly, Biexponential)
transform(SFC_GatingSet, MyBiexTransform)
```
A GatingSet with 6 samples

And finally, we apply the template to the GatingSet
```{r}
gt_gating(TheFullTemplate, SFC_GatingSet)
```

# Problem 3

We have already stablished singlets, lymphocytes, live, Tcells, CD4 and CD8 gates. I don't have too much knowledge about inmunology or how to recognize these different populations in the FACS since I don't work with this kind of samples, so I decided to add DN and the different TNFa and IFNg populations as gates based on an example that we saw during the course:

```{r}
flowGate::gs_gate_interactive(gs=SFC_GatingSet, filterId="DN", sample=2, dims=list("BV650-A", "BUV805-A"), subset="Tcells")
```
